The <b>Shell Satchel</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Yellow|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It increases the maximum quantity of {{CrestSlot|Red|s}} available to use.

== Usefulness ==
The specific increase for each Tool varies based on its carrying capacity and [[Tool Pouch]] upgrades.

Swapping to a [[Crest]] that does not have the Shell Satchel equipped, unequipping the Shell Satchel, or obtaining a new Crest causes the extra tools to disappear, forcing Hornet to craft new ones when the Shell Satchel is re-equipped, using up her [[Shell Shards]] and potentially draining her [[Flea Brew]] and [[Plasmium Phial]] reserves.

Obtaining a new Crest removes the tools even if the Shell Satchel is equipped in the Vesticrest.

== How to Acquire ==
The Shell Satchel can be found on a corpse in the northeast portion of the [[Wormways]] during {{Steel Soul Icon Mini|SS}} [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]], replacing the [[Dead Bug's Purse]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Dead Bugs Purse.png!Location in the Wormways
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Dead Bug's Purse Room.png!Room where the Shell Satchel is acquired
}}

== Tool Combo Tips ==
{{SS Table Tool Interactions
| Tool1 = Plasmium Phial
| Tool1Desc = With a fully upgraded [[Tool Pouch]] and the Shell Satchel equipped, Hornet can hold seven Plasmium Phials, which is enough to become [[plasmified]] by killing the [[Winged Lifeseed]]s of only one [[Plasmium Cocoon]]. This makes it possible to become plasmified before [[Act 3]] and without using the [[Architect Crest]].
}}
